subject: [PATCH] userfaultfd: wait on source PMD during UFFDIO_MOVE

2026-07-11.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the userfaultfd code where it incorrectly passes a pointer to src_pmdval instead of the actual PMD (page-table entry) when calling pmd_migration_entry_wait(). The fix involves passing the correct PMD, src_pmd, which matches the behavior in other parts of the kernel. This change ensures that the wait operation is properly synchronized with the real page-table lock, preventing potential issues on split-PMD-lock kernels.
